source_pool: Previously reserved test groups in partial-records pool, excluding all 38 prior selected groups
selection: Existing reserved hash order; take first 12 independent groups with two explicit, distinct-role literal facts. Reject ambiguous roles, credentials, clinical-sensitive fields, or targets exposed in field description. Whole source group reserved together. Review only, no model-based selection.
configs: Previous eight goal/observation configurations plus both requested/failed first lookup and first observed/failed second lookup; direct and prose controlled wording.
fresh_evaluation: 12 sources x 10 configs x atomic/compound x prose only; no new training sources from this pool.
budget_diagnostic: Existing reviewed BEAM dev (52 states, 12 sources), same histories and numeric-answer contract; 128 and 512 tokens. All 52 banks exceed 128, all diagnostic support fits <=84. Previously used dev, not fresh confirmation.
eligibility_detail: Require separable role-specific quotes within one original user paragraph. Unordered parallel lists with ambiguous role alignment, unsupported direction, credential-bearing sources, and native query/source domain mismatches are not selected. Derived questions may narrow to a coherent subtask explicitly present in the passage.
